en: Black‑and‑white view of a quiet town square with half‑timbered and plastered houses. In the foreground left is a large, ornate half‑timber building with a steep slate roof and dormers. Further back, centered, rises a baroque-style church tower with a bulbous helmet roof and lantern. Gabled houses frame the square, and a few small figures stand in the street. One building at right appears to bear the partially visible word 'Restaurant' on its facade. The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century European village scene.
